column1: # analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv -- the effect of a routine on the WRAM bank in force, for the backward scan of tools/apply_ram_operands.py (docs/research/naming2_ramop7.md)

# effect: `keeps` = the routine writes no bank register, or saves the hWRAMBank shadow at entry and restores the registers from it at exit (Sound_FrameService sets rSVBK = 1 and restores only rSVBK from the shadow): the real bank

#         after the call is the one before it only while hWRAMBank == rSVBK at entry (the shadow-desync window of docs/research/naming2_verify_ramop7.md section 4c: 5 executed call sites of the ramop9 rows return in a bank not seen before);
#         `sets W7` = it is bank 7 after the call (the routine selects it and does not restore);
#         `keeps if A=0` = the same as `keeps` when A is the constant 0 at the call (the routine takes a bank in A, 0 meaning none: BankSwitch_H and the routines that go through it).

# The rows of the mail library (bank 0F) and the sound driver (bank 04) rest on two invariants checked in docs/research/naming2_verify_ramop10.md: L5 (bank 0F is entered only through Mail_DispatchFar after the bank 5 idiom and
# writes no WRAM bank register) and S1 (bank 04 is entered only through the 13 stubs of home/audio.asm, whose callers select bank 1).

# A routine that is not listed is unknown: a call to it between a bank switch and a site ends the proof.  Every row says how the effect was read; a conditional call (`call nz, X`) is never a proof (the 20 `Mail_*_NextPage` rows of the library
# document it and are never read: they are called with `call nz|c`).
